mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals rising demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST does not rise consistently for 3 months or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the trigger does not occur or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals accommodative monetary policy and improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not result in positive 20-day returns or the effect reverses in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous easing of monetary policy (FEDFUNDS falling) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the regime's conditions (FEDFUNDS < 0.15 AND UNRATE < 5.0) are not met or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not rise consistently for 3 months or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 107.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the trigger does not occur or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in demand (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not result in positive 20-day returns or the effect reverses in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.15 and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in a loose monetary environment.
failure_condition: If the trigger does not occur or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
